notes.title: Updates and Fixbugs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949847/0155620811f78e18bd426bf8aedb4705855e204e.png[/img]

Hello everyone, thank you so much for playing Wife Quest and give us tons of feedback. Your opinions are crucial to us. We listen to you, and we made improvements to the game.

Updates:

[list]
[*] The mana cost of abilities was reduced.
[*] The Tania boss fight was rebalanced.
[*] Heavy Mace Adjustments. It was reduced the charge time, and it isn't reset the skill when Mia takes damage.
[*] Removed the level restrictions on bags at Ymir store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949847/b27e08f6a053b98af944a6240f490d1e098e2248.gif[/img]

[*] Wife Quest has progress markers now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949847/838cff5a1f3f085202ebbcbc4224495e69278ed8.gif[/img]

[*] The shield can be used in jumps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949847/531bdd846251cf2e3b65df01edd1327ff13ece63.gif[/img]

[*] Added languages: Spanish and French.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949847/aee7eb5fb01fd9db0049597f4ec31562581f99ad.gif[/img]
[/list]

Fixbugs:

[list]
[*] troll girl doesn't move.
[*] Joystick mapping settings aren't saved.
[*] Boss hp in GUI.
[*] Skills and projectiles don't hit multiple targets.
[*] Position and layers of props in Hellcano.
[*] Enabled OneWayPlatforms in the 2nd form of Tania and Fria.
[*] Same audios play simultaneously.
[*] Sily getting stuck on edges and corners in the fight at Hellcano.
[/list]

Thank you, guys. More suggestions? Found any bugs? Please report them to us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1554600/discussions/]community hub[/url].
Don't miss anything from the [url=https://pippingames.com]Pippin Game[/url]! Follow us on [url=https://linktr.ee/PippinGames]social media[/url] and here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/pippingames]Steam[/url]!

notes.title: Wife Quest Devlog #7
notes.content:
Hello everyone, another Wife Quest update!

This time we bring you Morganna's Castle:

[list]
[*] New level in Morganna's domains.
[*] All the monster girls are here!
[*] Including previous Bosses.
[*] Use all of Mia's skills to avoid the traps the little witch has set up.
[*] And finally give her a good lesson... Don't forget to save Fernando!
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to Wife Quest!
notes.content:
Hello guys! And thank you so much for follow Wife Quest!

We're pleased to have you here!
This is our first post on the game page! We want to show you a little bit about this exciting adventure in the creation of Wife Quest!

The begin!

We wanted to make a game that goes with the classic "[b] The hero rescues the princess [/b]"! but on the contrary, where "[b] the princess rescues the hero! [/b]".
With that theme in mind, we started the concept of the game:

"[b] Rescue your husband who has been kidnapped! [/b]"

Wife Quest started as a simple one-month prototype! What we Indies developers call [i] Game Jam [/i]!

[previewyoutube=aAdpUjx1VAM;full][/previewyoutube]

We were so excited about the idea that we decided, Wife Quest will be our next game! We refined the concept, so our couple, [b] Fernando and Mia [/b], and the other [b] Monsters  Girls[/ b] Like [b] Morganna [/b] came into being!

In the game's plot, Mia has to [b] rescue her husband [/b], Fernando, who Morganna and her companions kidnaped! And this is the result of the refinement of Wife Quest!

[previewyoutube=YfK9mRWG4y4;full][/previewyoutube]

A big difference, isn't it ?!

We'll keep you informed of the game progress! We want to build [b] 6 levels [/b], each with its own [b] challenges, monster girls, bosses and storyline [/b]! It looks like Mia is going to have a lot of work to save Fernando!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39949847/d8402f98266a1ff27ce2a94546c06ad656903861.png[/img]

With your help, I'm sure Mia will save Fernando!

Are you excited about Wife Quest!? Don't forget to follow us on [url=https://linktr.ee/PippinGames]social media[/url] and [b] share [/b] with your Friends!
